title: Modified Power Auras
wikitext: '''Modified Power Auras''' (MPOWA) is an advanced version of the original Power Auras, designed to help you customize visual and audio alerts for various game events. == How to install == # Download manually via GitHub (click on [https://github.com/kxseven/ModifiedPowerAuras/releases Releases] -> Download Source code (zip) . # Extract the ColorPickerPlus and ModifiedPowerAuras folders into your twow/Interface/AddOns folder. # Restart / start the game. '''Note''': * Deleting mpowa's addon and lua files from WTF->SavedVariables. Resets mpowa's settings but fixes a issue with timers. == Git links == * [https://github.com/kxseven/ModifiedPowerAuras '''(kxseven)'''] * [https://github.com/MarcelineVQ/ModifiedPowerAuras '''(MarcelineVQ)'''] == Commands == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Description |- |/wa or /mpowa |Opens or toggles the MPOWA configuration window |} == Usage == '''Creating and Managing Auras''' * '''Add Aura:''' Click the "Add" button in the main window to create a new aura. * '''Edit Aura:''' Select an existing aura from the list and click "Edit" to adjust its settings. * '''Remove Aura:''' Select an aura and click "Remove" to delete it. * '''Test All:''' Click the "Test All" button to preview all active auras. '''Profiles''' * '''Import Profile:''' Use the "Import" button in the profile window to load saved aura profiles. * '''Save Profile:''' Save your current aura setup via the "Save" button. * '''Remove Profile:''' Delete a selected profile with the "Remove" button. '''Icon Selection''' * Open the icon frame with the icon button, then select an icon from the list. * Use the color swatch to pick icon colors. * Confirm with "Okay" or cancel with "Cancel". == Preview == [[File:Mpa1.png|frameless|480x480px]] == Features == * Use Icons instead of symbols * More performant * Show stacks of auras * Show double procs (Holy strength) * Show enemy buffs and debuffs * Show your buffs and debuffs * Show cooldown on trinkets or abilities * Customize your aura and its position on the whole screen * Use a lot new conditions to show/hide auras * Play a sound if a aura is applied or fades * Have some nice animations * Group them as they appear * Set up custom functions to show or hide the aura * Bundling of ColorPickerPlus add-on to allow HTML based color codes for consistent coloring * Support for Forms/Stances == Contributors == * [https://github.com/tdymel/ModifiedPowerAuras Shino] (Author) * [https://github.com/kxseven kxseven] (Improved, Updated) * [https://github.com/shikulja shikulja] (Russian localization) * [https://github.com/d95mca d95mca] [[Category:Addon]]
